schema.description: Strict supplied conflict candidates with complete guarded JSON, optional reported confidence and evidence. Parsed data fits 2 MiB UTF-8 JSON. Selection and confirmation are identity-only requests, never a resolved state.

Strict supplied validation report and complete issue context/evidence, with a collective 2 MiB parsed UTF-8 JSON limit. Reported status is independent of issue count and severity; no validation, correction or authority is inferred.

proofLimits: Two new conflict-validation archive/source profiles. Closed record-inspection, evidence-review, file-review, hosting and older packets are not replayed.

React 19.2.8 and TypeScript 5.9.3, four installed ConflictResolver/ValidationSummary SSR profiles and strict public types. Complete candidate JSON and issue context/evidence, native confidence meters and independent reported validation are inspected as supplied claims, never verified accuracy or resolution. No browser, modal claim, source verification, fetching, persistence, external MCP host, permission grant or model execution in this helper.
Seven locally generated archives are not public npm package-name installs. Fresh transitive locks are retained rather than equated with the workspace lock.
The outer supervisor owns namespace scanning and final scratch removal. This helper checks its direct children, streams and original process groups.
